1476: 		 * 									<ol>
1477: 		 * 									<li>the {@link #size(int, int)} has
1478: 		 * 									not yet been called to specify the
1479: 		 * 									size of the thumbnail, or</li>
1480: 		 * 									<li>the {@link #scale(double)}
1481: 		 * 									method has been called, or</li>
1482: 		 * 									<li>the
1483: 		 * 									{@link #scale(double, double)}
1484: 		 * 									method has been called, or</li>
1485: 		 * 									<li>the {@link #width(int)} and/or
1486: 		 * 									{@link #height(int)} has been called
1487: 		 * 									and not preserving the aspect ratio
1488: 		 * 									is desired.</li>
1489: 		 * 									</ol>
1490: 		 */
1491: 		public Builder<T> keepAspectRatio(boolean keep) {
1492: 			if (statusMap.get(Properties.SCALE) == Status.ALREADY_SET) {
1493: 				throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot specify whether to " +
1494: 						"keep the aspect ratio if the scaling factor has " +
1495: 						"already been specified.");
1496: 			}
1497: 			if (statusMap.get(Properties.SIZE) == Status.NOT_READY) {
1498: 				throw new IllegalStateException("Cannot specify whether to " +
1499: 						"keep the aspect ratio unless the size parameter has " +
1500: 						"already been specified.");
1501: 			}
1502: 			if ((statusMap.get(Properties.WIDTH) == Status.ALREADY_SET ||
1503: 					statusMap.get(Properties.HEIGHT) == Status.ALREADY_SET) &&
1504: 					!keep
1505: 			) {
1506: 				throw new IllegalStateException("The aspect ratio must be " +
1507: 						"preserved when the width and/or height parameter " +
1508: 						"has already been specified.");
1509: 			}
1510: 			
1511: 			updateStatus(Properties.KEEP_ASPECT_RATIO, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1512: 			keepAspectRatio = keep;
1513: 			return this;
1514: 		}
1515: 		
1516: 		/**
1517: 		 * Sets the output quality of the compression algorithm used to
1518: 		 * compress the thumbnail when it is written to an external destination
1519: 		 * such as a file or output stream.
1520: 		 * <p>
1521: 		 * The value is a {@code float} between {@code 0.0f} and {@code 1.0f}
1522: 		 * where {@code 0.0f} indicates the minimum quality and {@code 1.0f}
1523: 		 * indicates the maximum quality settings should be used for by the
1524: 		 * compression codec.
1525: 		 * <p>
1526: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1527: 		 * <p>
1528: 		 * Calling this method in conjunction with {@link #asBufferedImage()}
1529: 		 * or {@link #asBufferedImages()} will not result in any changes to the
1530: 		 * final result.
1531: 		 * <p>
1532: 		 * Calling this method multiple times, or the
1533: 		 * {@link #outputQuality(double)} in conjunction with this method will
1534: 		 * result in an {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1535: 		 * <p>
1536: 		 * <em>
1537: 		 * Implementation note:
1538: 		 * Compression quality settings are ignored when the underlying
1539: 		 * image writer does not support compression. This behavior is subject
1540: 		 * to change in the future.
1541: 		 * </em>
1542: 		 * 
1543: 		 * @param quality		The compression quality to use when writing
1544: 		 * 						the thumbnail.
1545: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1546: 		 * @throws IllegalArgumentException	If the argument is less than
1547: 		 * 									{@code 0.0f} or is greater than
1548: 		 * 									{@code 1.0f}.
1549: 		 */
1550: 		public Builder<T> outputQuality(float quality) {
1551: 			if (quality < 0.0f || quality > 1.0f) {
1552: 				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1553: 						"The quality setting must be in the range 0.0f and " +
1554: 						"1.0f, inclusive."
1555: 				);
1556: 			}
1557: 			updateStatus(Properties.OUTPUT_QUALITY, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1558: 			outputQuality = quality;
1559: 			return this;
1560: 		}
1561: 		
1562: 		/**
1563: 		 * Sets the output quality of the compression algorithm used to
1564: 		 * compress the thumbnail when it is written to an external destination
1565: 		 * such as a file or output stream.
1566: 		 * <p>
1567: 		 * The value is a {@code double} between {@code 0.0d} and {@code 1.0d}
1568: 		 * where {@code 0.0d} indicates the minimum quality and {@code 1.0d}
1569: 		 * indicates the maximum quality settings should be used for by the
1570: 		 * compression codec.
1571: 		 * <p>
1572: 		 * This method is a convenience method for {@link #outputQuality(float)}
1573: 		 * where the {@code double} argument type is accepted instead of a
1574: 		 * {@code float}.
1575: 		 * <p>
1576: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1577: 		 * <p>
1578: 		 * Calling this method in conjunction with {@link #asBufferedImage()}
1579: 		 * or {@link #asBufferedImages()} will not result in any changes to the
1580: 		 * final result.
1581: 		 * <p>
1582: 		 * Calling this method multiple times, or the
1583: 		 * {@link #outputQuality(float)} in conjunction with this method will
1584: 		 * result in an {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1585: 		 * <p>
1586: 		 * <em>
1587: 		 * Implementation note:
1588: 		 * Compression quality settings are ignored when the underlying
1589: 		 * image writer does not support compression. This behavior is subject
1590: 		 * to change in the future.
1591: 		 * </em>
1592: 		 * 
1593: 		 * @param quality		The compression quality to use when writing
1594: 		 * 						the thumbnail.
1595: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1596: 		 * @throws IllegalArgumentException	If the argument is less than
1597: 		 * 									{@code 0.0d} or is greater than
1598: 		 * 									{@code 1.0d}.
1599:  		 */
1600: 		public Builder<T> outputQuality(double quality) {
1601: 			if (quality < 0.0d || quality > 1.0d) {
1602: 				throw new IllegalArgumentException(
1603: 						"The quality setting must be in the range 0.0d and " +
1604: 						"1.0d, inclusive."
1605: 				);
1606: 			}
1607: 			
1608: 			updateStatus(Properties.OUTPUT_QUALITY, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1609: 			outputQuality = (float)quality;
1610: 			if (outputQuality < 0.0f) {
1611: 				outputQuality = 0.0f;
1612: 			} else if (outputQuality > 1.0f) {
1613: 				outputQuality = 1.0f;
1614: 			}
1615: 			return this;
1616: 		}
1617: 		
1618: 		/**
1619: 		 * Sets the compression format to use when writing the thumbnail.
1620: 		 * <p>
1621: 		 * For example, to set the output format to JPEG, the following code
1622: 		 * can be used:
1623: 		 * <pre><code>
1624: Thumbnails.of(image)
1625:     .size(640, 480)
1626:     .outputFormat("JPEG")
1627:     .toFile(thumbnail);
1628: 		 * </code></pre>
1629: 		 * or, alternatively:
1630: 		 * <pre><code>
1631: Thumbnails.of(image)
